deck.title: Generate a whole deck
deck.description: Describe your talk. AI plans an outline for you to review, then writes the slides with speaker notes.
deck.mockCapability: No AI key is configured on this server. The deck will be built from placeholder text (mock mode), not by an AI.

form.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Zero trust security for new engineers
form.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. new hires, a board meeting, 8th graders
form.sourceHint: Paste notes or an article and the deck is based on it. It is only used for this deck and is never followed as instructions.

errors.topicShort: Enter a topic of at least {min} characters.
errors.languageInvalid: Enter a language name such as English or Español.
errors.sourceLong: The source material can hold up to {max} characters.
errors.includeNone: Include at least one kind of slide.

includes.contentHint: Headings, text, bullets, quotes, big numbers
includes.pollsHint: Opinion polls, word clouds, ratings, open questions
includes.quizHint: Graded questions with a right answer

planning.title: Planning the outline
planning.hint: This usually takes a few seconds.

outline.title: Review the outline
outline.hint: Rename sections, reword what a slide covers, change its type, reorder or remove slides. Slides are written when you continue.
outline.mockNotice: This outline is placeholder text from mock mode, not from an AI.

errors.title: Give the deck a title.
errors.empty: The deck needs at least one slide.
errors.tooMany: A deck can have at most {max} slides.

writing.title: Writing your deck
writing.hint: Writing {count, plural, one {# slide} other {# slides}} with speaker notes. This can take up to a minute; keep this window open.

result.title: Your deck is ready
result.summary: {slides, plural, one {# slide} other {# slides}}, {notes} with speaker notes
result.aiNotice: Generated by AI. Check the facts before you present.
result.usage: {used} of {limit} AI decks used this month

mockNotice.title: Generated with mock data (no AI key configured)
mockNotice.body: The slides and speaker notes are placeholders. Replace them with your own content before presenting.

warnings.title: {count, plural, one {# thing to check} other {# things to check}}

errors.limit: You have used all {max} AI decks included in this month's plan. Mock decks are not limited.
errors.limitGeneric: You have reached your plan's monthly limit for AI decks.
errors.rate: Too many AI requests in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.provider: The AI provider did not respond. Try again in a moment.
errors.empty: No valid slides could be generated. Try again, or change the outline.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to create decks in this workspace.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while generating the deck.
